abstract: Best practices for astro-plugin-hellajs, the Astro 7 integration for HellaJS: registering hellajs() in the integrations array (exclusive-use, no options), island hydration behind client:* directives (client:only carries the renderer name), Astro slots consumed as props.children raw HTML, statically foldable css()/style()/keyframes() frontmatter calls with the cssText() opt-out and vars() sheet flushes, and server resolution of JSX-bearing @hellajs/* packages through the ssr export condition the integration adds - never ssr.noExternal or aliases. Every rule is grounded in the plugin source and test suite.
